# Battery Technology Residual Value Impact

- Document Class: Hypothesis
- Status: Active
- Date: 2026-05-10
- Category: EV residual value
- Scope: How battery technology shifts may affect older EV value.
- Sources: `raw/research/2026-05-10-ev-battery-technologies/research-summary.md`
- Related: `wiki/specs/ev-battery-technology-landscape.spec.md`; `wiki/roadmaps/battery-commercialization-timeline.roadmap.md`

## Hypothesis

Battery technology shifts will affect older EV residual values unevenly. Near-term depreciation pressure is more likely to come from cheaper LFP/LMFP vehicles and incremental lithium-ion improvements than from all-solid-state batteries. Solid-state and lithium-sulfur are more likely to matter after they reach high-volume production and price competitiveness.

## Rationale

The largest current commercial shift is LFP scaling, not all-solid-state replacement. LFP reduces cost and improves perceived durability for mainstream EVs. Silicon-anode improvements can increase range and charging while staying inside the lithium-ion platform. LMR may reduce the cost of long-range trucks and SUVs by the late 2020s.

Solid-state, semi-solid, and lithium-sulfur may reshape expectations, but early products are likely to be limited, premium, or demonstrator-scale.

## What Would Confirm It

- New LFP/LMFP EVs undercut older used EV prices while offering adequate range and stronger warranty confidence.
- Used high-nickel EVs hold value mainly when range, charging, brand support, and battery health remain strong.
- Solid-state launches stay low-volume and premium through the late 2020s.

## What Would Falsify It

- A major OEM launches high-volume, low-cost all-solid-state EVs before 2030.
- Lithium-sulfur or sodium-ion reaches mass-market passenger EV scale with strong warranty terms before expected.
- Used-EV buyers ignore chemistry and price vehicles almost entirely by range, age, and brand.

## Evidence Needed Next

Collect used-EV residual value data by model, chemistry, age, mileage, warranty status, battery health, charging standard, and replacement-pack cost.
